_: Film d'accueil 45 s « bande-annonce » (19/10/2026). Texte validé par Kévin le 19/10 à 14 h 23 : « pourquoi nous et pas un autre terminal » (on trie, on publie nos résultats même quand on a tort, le niveau pro sans le prix pro). Le casting (branche bande-casting) a été lu avec la première version du texte.

lines.text: Tokyo opens. London takes over. New York shakes the world.
Every day, thousands of numbers. Other terminals give you all of them.
MACROARSENAL tells you which ones matter. Live.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal tells you which ones matter. Live.

lines.text: Every morning, our read on the markets. Every evening, the verdict, published. Even when we're wrong.
And before every trade, Doji checks everything. Your plan. The levels. The calendar. Your risk.
All the power of the pros. Without the price.
MACROARSENAL. The terminal that changes how you see trading.
lines.tts: Macro Arsenal. The terminal that changes how you see trading.

voices.label: EN, grave de cinéma (américain)
voices.design: A deep, powerful American male movie trailer narrator in his fifties: a very low, resonant bass voice with a touch of gravel and immense authority, the classic voice of Hollywood blockbuster trailers. Native General American accent. Close-microphone professional voice-over studio sound, rich low end, natural breathing, human and alive, never robotic.

voices.label: EN, motivation brute et vraie
voices.design: An American man in his late thirties with a deep, warm, slightly raspy voice, the narrator of viral motivational videos: real, raw and human, speaking from the heart with total conviction. Native General American accent. Recorded close to a high-end studio microphone, natural breathing, real human texture and small imperfections, never robotic, never synthetic.
voices.acting: Deliver it like the voice-over of a viral motivational video: natural, human and conversational, never theatrical, never announcer-like. Speak with real conviction and energy, a lively, dynamic rhythm with short punchy pauses, stress the key words, and let the intensity build up to a powerful, inspiring last line. Sounds like a real person talking from the heart, never shouting.

voices.acting: Deliver it like the voice-over of a viral motivational video: natural, human and conversational, never theatrical, never announcer-like. Speak with real conviction and energy, a lively, dynamic rhythm with short punchy pauses, stress the key words, and let the intensity build up to a powerful, inspiring last line. acting: Read it like an epic, cinematic movie trailer voice-over for a world-class product: slow, deep and powerful, with long dramatic pauses between sentences. Short sentences land like hammer blows. Low, resonant chest voice, quiet intensity that builds steadily towards the end; the final line is grand, confident and unforgettable. Never shouting, never rushed, every word crystal clear.
